scope: Independent release, provenance, packaging and public offline replay review. This review does not replace the frozen numerical audit or assess novelty and human semantic validity.
public_guards_reviewed: Public export and replay reject synthetic or mixed fixture evidence; only private test helpers permit explicit fixtures.
Replay checks the exact file inventory, safe paths, every bundle hash, source closure and self hash before metric imports.
The original passing both-model audit, test seal, reconstruction seal, output hashes, selected sites, row populations and original capture identities are verified.

Derived NPZ loading uses allow_pickle=False, an exact allowed array inventory, joined row/arm/factor identities, finite margins and strict Boolean flags; no hidden-state vectors or fitted coefficients are shipped.

Actual projected rows were independently compared with every corresponding native row and retained scalar field for both checkpoints; all nine losslessly compressed originals match their native source bytes.
Public presentation loading requires exact audited embedded result bytes, report/receipt/campaign bindings and matching shared context sets; it does not rerun scientific analysis.
Global NPZ ignore remains intact. Only the two exact audited derived prediction files are staged; the user-modified review packet is excluded from the index.
The source-distribution include is narrowed to this replay directory for NPZ, gzip and text; the large-file exemption is narrowed to the exact immutable report summary.

ci_review.new_workflow_execution: Pending release commit; this review verifies current workflow source and independently executes the real Windows replay and exact slides dependency profile. It does not claim these uncommitted workflow additions have run remotely.

It installed six declared slides packages. All four slide XMLs and speaker-note bytes equal the delivered actual deck.

environment.configuration_tool: configurePythonEnvironment and getPythonExecutableCommand were attempted twice but returned an unknown-thread host error in this delegated thread. The already-chosen explicit project interpreter and locked uv profile were verified by successful execution; no editor-selected-interpreter claim is made.

plugins.graphify: Existing 727-node graph queried for navigation; graph is stale for the new study, so all release conclusions use direct source and runtime/byte evidence. No graph rebuild or additional plugin used.

limits: This public replay reuses the frozen production metric functions. It is metric reproducibility from derived predictions, not an independent feature-to-prediction reconstruction; that full audit remains a separate native artifact.

Raw prompts, tokenizer inputs, activation vectors and fitted heads are deliberately absent from the lightweight replay bundle. Original native evidence remains necessary for end-to-end reconstruction.

The package archive hash identifies the exact archive inspected before subsequent documentation-only updates; final package rebuilds may legitimately have a different archive hash. The immutable replay-member hashes must remain identical.

Human semantic review remains incomplete. Agent review, passing code checks and reliable packaging do not establish publication novelty, spontaneous belief anticipation, causal internal computation or actual deception.
Remote CI for the final release commit must still complete; only pre-release local checks and source wiring are certified here.
